==Status==

I argue that Lannis is not a Blue sister of the current time. I don't remember [[Saerin Asnobar|Saerin]]'s exact paraphrasing, but there is something about the way she talks about Lannis that implies that she is someone lone gone. Yes, I definitely argue that Saerin consulted a book written by the Blue sister Lannis who lived once upon a time, rather than the book of a living sister, since she in that case likely have asked the supposedly alive Lannis for further evidence on [[Mesaana]], or simply have brought her before [[Egwene]]. How about that? I argue that her status should at least be "Unknown" if not "Dead".
